from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """One extracted financial record from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company in the report")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities code if provided in the report")
    metric_name: str = Field(description="Name of the financial item reported (e.g., '非流动资产合计')")
    metric_value: str = Field(description="Numerical value of the item, kept as string to preserve precision")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency or unit (e.g., '元')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Time period of the report (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
